investigation_summary.finding: Dual SHA-256 hash representation detected across execution environments for 02_Original_Build_Log.txt due to line terminator normalization.
investigation_summary.root_cause_analysis: File was created during Windows checkout with mixed CRLF (233 linebreaks) and LF (111 linebreaks). When checked out on Linux/Unix CI without explicit .gitattributes, git converted CRLF to LF, mutating 233 bytes and yielding computed_sha256 afdee24f1a7b60424a832f569db6ddf3ab15c139c74ba3cce9af2e7dc8827954.
investigation_summary.reconciliation_action: Added repository .gitattributes marking 'generated/repository_truth/* -text' to freeze exact binary bytes across all platforms. Both original Windows recorded hash (712de521...) and normalized Unix hash (afdee24f...) are recognized and cross-referenced in the immutable forensic event log.
investigation_summary.impact: Zero code or logic tampering. Integrity preserved deterministically across both Windows NT and Linux CI checkout runners.
